name: Input Buffer
description: Click a few ticks early and the click is moved to the tick where it actually works.

timing-help.name: How to read the timing numbers
timing-help.description:
Geometry Dash runs its physics at 240 ticks per second.

1 tick = 1 frame at 240 FPS
4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 FPS

A window of N ticks means: if you click up to N ticks before the moment the click actually needed to happen, the mod holds your click and plays it on the tick that works. Click earlier than N ticks and it goes through unchanged, exactly like vanilla.

If you change Game Speed (TPS), windows are still measured in 240-TPS ticks so they mean the same amount of real time.

main-window.name: Main Buffer Window
main-window.description: The default window for every gamemode. 'Off' turns the whole mod off. Every gamemode below set to -1 uses this value.

landing-title.name: Landing and orb modes
landing-title.description:
Modes where a click is a single jump: cube, ball, robot, spider. A click a little before you land (or before you reach an orb) is moved to the landing / orb tick.

-1 = use the Main Buffer Window
0 = no buffering in this mode
1 or more = custom window in ticks for this mode

cube-window.name: Cube Window (ticks)
cube-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

ball-window.name: Ball Window (ticks)
ball-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

robot-window.name: Robot Window (ticks)
robot-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks. Robot presses are simulated as held.

spider-window.name: Spider Window (ticks)
spider-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

flying-title.name: Flying modes
flying-title.description:
Modes where you hold to go up: ship, UFO, swing, wave. Presses that would crash are moved to the first tick that survives. In ship, swing and wave (Grid mode) releases are buffered the same way.

-1 = use the Main Buffer Window
0 = no buffering in this mode
1 or more = custom window in ticks for this mode

ship-window.name: Ship Window (ticks)
ship-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

ufo-window.name: UFO Window (ticks)
ufo-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

swing-window.name: Swing Window (ticks)
swing-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

wave-window.name: Wave Window (ticks)
wave-window.description: -1 = use main window, 0 = off, otherwise ticks.

wave-mode.name: Wave Mode
wave-mode.description:
Off: wave is never buffered.
Press Only: only presses are moved to a surviving tick.
Grid: presses AND releases are moved, so both corners of every wave zig-zag land on the tick that fits the gap.

hotkeys-title.name: Hotkeys
hotkeys-title.description: Press the key in game to change the setting without opening this menu. A small notification confirms the new value.

key-cycle-window.name: Key: Cycle Main Window
key-cycle-window.description: Cycles the Main Buffer Window through Off and every preset.

key-cycle-wave.name: Key: Cycle Wave Mode
key-cycle-wave.description: Cycles Wave Mode: Off -> Press Only -> Grid.

tps.name: Game Speed (TPS)
tps.description: Physics ticks per second. 240 is vanilla. Higher values run more, smaller physics steps per frame (like a physics bypass), which makes every window finer. Values other than 240 change how the game physics feel and are not accepted on most lists.

look-ahead.name: Look-ahead (ticks)
look-ahead.description: How far into the future each click is checked for a death, in ticks (240 = 1 second). Higher catches deaths further away but costs more time per click. Lower this if clicks stutter.

hold-length.name: Assumed hold length (ticks)
hold-length.description: Flying modes only. The preview assumes a press is held this many ticks and then released, and a release is followed by a re-press this many ticks later. Lower if you tap very fast (wave spam), higher if you hold longer. 240 ticks = 1 second.

simulate-moving.name: Preview moving objects
simulate-moving.description: Measures how fast nearby platforms, saws and other moving objects are travelling and carries that motion forward during the preview, instead of treating them as stationary. Needed for levels with moving parts. It is an approximation: it cannot know that a move is about to stop or change direction.

simulate-interactables.name: Preview uses orbs, pads and gravity portals
simulate-interactables.description: The preview player activates orbs, jump pads and gravity portals it touches (their state is restored afterwards). Turn off to preview against solid blocks and hazards only.

sim-budget.name: Max simulated ticks per click
sim-budget.description: Hard cap on simulation work for a single click so a click can never freeze the game. If the cap is reached before a surviving tick is found, the click goes through unchanged.

buffer-releases.name: Buffer releases (ship / swing / robot)
buffer-releases.description: Also move releases that would crash you to the first tick that survives. Wave releases are controlled by Wave Mode.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: While the buffer is on, levels run in test mode so completions, percentages and stats are not saved. Keeps buffered runs off your profile and off leaderboards.

show-label.name: Show status label
show-label.description: Shows the current window, wave mode and TPS in the bottom-left corner while playing.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Writes one line per decision to the Geode log (geode/logs): mode, window, chosen delay, how many simulations it took and how long it took.
